basic_details.job_title: District Hospital Chandrapur ART Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 62 years (as on date of Advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with valid registration from the respective State Medical Council/NMC; minimum 6 months work experience; good working knowledge of computer MS Office. Post Graduates from Clinical Discipline will also be considered.
qualification.details: Other conditions: | Good working knowledge of computer MS office | Desirable: | Work Experience in HIV/AIDS Program in field setting Those with MD Medicine / Diploma in Medicine will be preferred

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form attached with the advertisement.
Use A4 size paper for the application.
Attach a recent passport size photograph and a set of attested photocopies of testimonials/certificates/ID proof.
Send by registered/speed post or submit in person at the office of the Civil Surgeon, District Hospital, Main Road Chhota Bazar, Chandrapur 442402.
In-person submission on all working days between the advertised date and closing date.
Application must be received by 20 November 2026 till 5.00 pm.
important_instructions: All further correspondence, including call letters, will be done only by email Write personal email ID and contact number correctly and neatly in the application form Candidate should apply separately for each post Applications received after 20 November 2026, 5.00 pm will not be considered Project Director, MSACS, Mumbai reserves the right to cancel the recruitment or modify the number of posts Canvassing in any way will lead to disqualification

content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of District Hospital, Chandrapur, dated 6 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Hospital Chandrapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Hospital Chandrapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for ART Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Hospital Chandrapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Format attached with the advertisement (notice says Page no 4&5; it is on pages 3-4 of this PDF)) and send it to Civil Surgeon, District Hospital, Main Road Chhota Bazar, Chandrapur 442402, by registered post, speed post or in person, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 62 years (as on date of Advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.72000 consolidated monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with valid registration from the respective State Medical Council/NMC; minimum 6 months work experience; good working knowledge of computer MS Office. Post Graduates from Clinical Discipline will also be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Good working knowledge of computer MS office.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have been discontinued based on poor performance. Candidates retired from Government Services against whom disciplinary action is completed OR initiated.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications received in due date. Interview of short-listed candidates. Applications received in due date will be scrutinised. Short-listed candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is temporary and purely on contract basis. Continuation will be applicable up to 65 years for contractual service.
